answer: Audits are entered in onyx, queued in wharf, and grove publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 22 identities per epoch. A farm of 62 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1982 identities would post 4456 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
